items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So, we became very good friends from then on.

ctx.x: Stan Kenton was the piano player in the band. And, he said, "Gee, I sure like -- I sure like the way you write right." He says, "Can you write some of them Earl things for me? The Earl Hines things."

I said, "Well, man, I don't if anybody can really write like Earl plays please." I say, "But, I'll try to write some of the changes and things for you and what not like that, you know." So, we became very good friends from then on.
